nl.title: WordPress herinstalleren of herstellen via CyberPanel zonder alles te wissen
nl.excerpt: WordPress herinstalleren of herstellen via CyberPanel zonder alles te wissen: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
WordPress via CyberPanel herstellen kan zonder meteen content te wissen: core-bestanden vernieuwen, database behouden, of schone install naast backup.

Scenario’s

  • Core corrupt: herstel WP-files, houd wp-content + DB.
  • Gehackt: clean core + scan plugins/themes + DB-cleanup.
  • Kapotte install: restore backup i.p.v. opnieuw “Install WordPress” over live data.

Veilige volgorde

  1. Volledige backup (files + DB).
  2. Noteer table-prefix en wp-config credentials.
  3. Herstel of herinstalleer volgens scenario.
  4. Log in, permalinks opslaan, cache legen.

Let op: ‘Install WordPress’ over een bestaande map kan wp-config/content overschrijven — lees de installeropties.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: WordPress installeren; malware; restore één site.

en.title: Restore WordPress herinstalleren or via CyberPanel without alles te wissen
en.excerpt: Restore WordPress herinstalleren or via CyberPanel without alles te wissen: backup, wp-admin, clear cache, verify.
en.bodyHtml:
For “Restore WordPress herinstalleren or via CyberPanel without alles te wissen” you work in WordPress (/wp-admin) on TripleZero iT hosting. Take a backup first; then change carefully and clear caches.

Preparation

  • Installatron or panel backup (files + database)
  • Login to /wp-admin of the correct site
  • DirectAdmin File Manager if wp-admin will not open

Steps

  1. Create a backup via Installatron or DirectAdmin.
  2. Sign in to /wp-admin.
  3. Apply the change in the menu that matches the topic (Plugins, Themes, Settings, Users, Media or WooCommerce).
  4. Save. On a critical error: via File Manager temporarily rename wp-content/plugins or activate a default theme.
  5. Clear page cache, object cache and CDN cache.
  6. Test the homepage, login and a critical flow (form or checkout).

Verify

  • No critical error
  • Change visible on the front end or in wp-admin

Tip: Change one plugin or theme at a time — faster rollback.

Note: Do not delete the uploads folder or database tables without a restore plan.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Installatron backup, PHP version, critical error.
